IndexDocument.description_en: The container for the default homepage

SupportSubDir.description_en:
Specifies whether to redirect to the default homepage in the subdirectory when a subdirectory is accessed. Valid values:
true: Redirects to the default homepage in the subdirectory.
false (default): Does not redirect to the default homepage in the subdirectory. Instead, redirects to the default homepage in the root directory.

For example, assume the default homepage is index.html and you want to access `bucket.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/subdir/`. If SupportSubDir is set to false, the request is redirected to `bucket.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/index.html`. If SupportSubDir is set to true, the request is redirected to `bucket.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/subdir/index.html`
SupportSubDir.description_zh:
访问子目录时，是否支持转到子目录下的默认主页。取值范围如下：
true：转到子目录下的默认主页。
false（默认）：不转到子目录下的默认主页，而是转到根目录下的默认主页。

假设默认主页为index.html，要访问`bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/subdir/`，如果设置SupportSubDir为false，则转到`bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/index.html`；如果设置SupportSubDir为true，则转到`bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/subdir/index.html`
SupportSubDir.title: 访问子目录时，是否支持跳转到子目录下的默认主页。

Type.description_en:
The behavior when the default homepage is set, the accessed object does not end with a forward slash (/), and the object does not exist. This parameter takes effect only when SupportSubDir is set to true. This parameter takes effect after RoutingRule but before ErrorFile.
For example, assume the default homepage is index.html, the file path to access is `bucket.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/abc`, and the object abc does not exist. The behaviors for different values of Type are as follows:
0 (default): Checks whether abc/index.html exists (in the format of `Object + forward slash (/) + homepage`). If it exists, a 302 response is returned with the Location header set to the URL-encoded form of `/abc/` (in the format of `forward slash (/) + Object + forward slash (/)`). If it does not exist, a 404 response is returned, and ErrorFile is checked.
1: Directly returns a 404 response with the NoSuchKey error, and ErrorFile is checked.
2: Checks whether abc/index.html exists. If it exists, the content of the object is returned. If it does not exist, a 404 response is returned, and ErrorFile is checked
Type.description_zh:
设置默认主页后，访问以非正斜线（/）结尾的Object，且该Object不存在时的行为。 只有设置SupportSubDir为true时才生效，且生效的顺序在RoutingRule之后、ErrorFile之前。
假设默认主页为index.html，要访问的文件路径为`bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/abc`，且abc这个Object不存在，此时Type的不同取值对应的行为如下：
0（默认）：检查abc/index.html是否存在（即`Object + 正斜线（/）+ 主页`的形式），如果存在则返回302，Location头为`/abc/`的URL编码（即`正斜线（/） + Object + 正斜线（/）`的形式），如果不存在则返回404，继续检查ErrorFile。
1：直接返回404，报错NoSuchKey，继续检查ErrorFile。
2：检查abc/index.html是否存在，如果存在则返回该Object的内容；如果不存在则返回404，继续检查ErrorFile
Type.title: 设置默认主页后，访问以非正斜线（/）结尾的Object，且该Object不存在时的行为。

MirrorCheckMd5.description_en:
Specifies whether to check the MD5 hash of the back-to-origin response body. This parameter takes effect only when RedirectType is set to Mirror.
If MirrorCheckMd5 is set to true and the response from the origin server contains the Content-Md5 header, OSS checks whether the MD5 hash of the retrieved data matches this header value. If the values do not match, the data is not stored in OSS.
Default value: false
MirrorCheckMd5.description_zh:
是否检查回源body的MD5。 只有设置RedirectType为Mirror时才生效。
当设置MirrorCheckMd5为true，并且源站返回的response中含有Content-Md5头时，OSS检查拉取的数据MD5是否与此Header匹配，如果不匹配，则不保存在OSS上。
默认值：false
MirrorCheckMd5.title: 是否检查回源body的MD5。 只有设置RedirectType为Mirror时才生效。

MirrorFollowRedirect.description_en:
Specifies whether to follow the redirect to the URL specified in the Location header if the mirroring-based back-to-origin response is 3xx. This parameter takes effect only when RedirectType is set to Mirror.
For example, when a mirroring-based back-to-origin request is initiated, the origin server returns 302 with a specified Location.
If this parameter is set to true, OSS continues to request the URL specified in the Location header.
A maximum of 10 redirects are allowed. If the number of redirects exceeds 10, a mirroring-based back-to-origin failure is returned.
If this parameter is set to false, OSS returns 302 and passes through the Location header.

Default value: true
MirrorFollowRedirect.description_zh:
如果镜像回源获取的结果为3xx，是否继续跳转到指定的Location获取数据。 只有设置RedirectType为Mirror时才生效。
例如发起镜像回源请求时，源站返回了302，并且指定了Location。
如果设置此项为true，则OSS会继续请求Location对应的地址。
最多能跳转10次，如果跳转超过10次，则返回镜像回源失败。
如果设置此项为false，则OSS会返回302，并透传Location。

默认值：true
MirrorFollowRedirect.title: 如果镜像回源获取的结果为3xx，是否继续跳转到指定的Location获取数据。 只有设置RedirectType为Mirror时才生效。

MirrorURL.description_en:
The address of the origin server for mirroring-based back-to-origin. This parameter takes effect only when RedirectType is set to Mirror.
The address of the origin server must start with **http://** or **https://** and end with a forward slash (/). OSS appends the object name to this URL to form the back-to-origin URL.
For example, if the object to access is myobject and this parameter is set to `http://example.com/`, the back-to-origin URL is `http://example.com/myobject`. If this parameter is set to `http://example.com/dir1/`, the back-to-origin URL is `http://example.com/dir1/myobject`.
If RedirectType is set to Mirror, this parameter is required
MirrorURL.description_zh:
镜像回源的源站地址。只有设置RedirectType为Mirror时才生效。
源站地址必须以**http://**或者**https://**开头，并且以正斜线（/）结尾，OSS会在此地址后带上Object名称组成回源URL。
例如要访问的Object名称为myobject，如果指定此项为`http://example.com/`，则回源URL为`http://example.com/myobject`，如果指定此项为`http://example.com/dir1/`，则回源URL为`http://example.com/dir1/myobject`。
如果RedirectType指定为Mirror，则必须指定此项
MirrorURL.title: 镜像回源的源站地址。只有设置RedirectType为Mirror时才生效。  源站地址必须以http://或者https://开头，并且以正斜线（/）结尾，OSS会在此地址后带上Object名称组成回源URL。

PassQueryString.description_en:
Specifies whether to include the request parameters of the original request in the redirect or mirroring-based back-to-origin request.
If a request to OSS includes the request parameter `?a=b&c=d` and PassQueryString is set to true, the request parameters are appended to the Location header for a 302 redirect. For example, `Location:example.com?a=b&c=d`. If the redirect type is mirroring-based back-to-origin, the request parameters are also included in the back-to-origin request.
Valid values: true, false (default)
PassQueryString.description_zh:
执行跳转或者镜像回源规则时，是否携带请求参数。
用户请求OSS时携带了请求参数`?a=b&c=d`，并且设置PassQueryString为true，如果规则为302跳转，则跳转的Location头中会添加此请求参数。例如`Location:example.com?a=b&c=d`，跳转类型为镜像回源，则在发起的回源请求中也会携带此请求参数。
取值：true、false（默认）
PassQueryString.title: 执行跳转或者镜像回源规则时，是否携带请求参数。

Protocol.description_en:
The protocol used for the redirect. This parameter takes effect only when RedirectType is set to External or AliCDN.
For example, if the object to access is test, the redirect destination is `example.com`, and Protocol is set to https, the Location header is `https://example.com/test`.
Valid values: http, https
Protocol.description_zh:
跳转时的协议。只有设置RedirectType为External或者AliCDN时才生效。
如果要访问的文件为test，设置跳转到`example.com`，并且设置Protocol为https，则Location头为`https://example.com/test`。
取值：http、https
Protocol.title: 跳转时的协议。只有设置RedirectType为External或者AliCDN时才生效。

RedirectType.description_en:
The type of the redirect. Valid values:
Mirror: mirroring-based back-to-origin.
External: external redirect. OSS returns a 3xx response that redirects the request to another URL.
AliCDN: Content Delivery Network (CDN) redirect. This value is mainly used for Alibaba Cloud CDN. Unlike External, OSS adds an additional header. After Content Delivery Network (CDN) identifies this header, it proactively redirects to the specified URL, retrieves the data, and returns the data to the user instead of returning the 3xx redirect response to the user.

If the parent node Redirect is specified, this parameter is required
RedirectType.description_zh:
指定跳转的类型。取值范围如下：
Mirror：镜像回源。
External：外部跳转，即OSS会返回一个3xx请求，指定跳转到另外一个地址。
AliCDN：阿里云CDN跳转，主要用于阿里云的CDN。与External不同的是，OSS会额外添加一个Header。阿里云CDN识别到此Header后会主动跳转到指定的地址，返回给用户获取到的数据，而不是将3xx跳转请求返回给用户。

如果指定了父节点Redirect，则必须指定此项
RedirectType.title: 指定跳转的类型。

ReplaceKeyPrefixWith.description_en:
The string that replaces the prefix of the object name during the redirect. If the prefix is empty, this string is prepended to the object name.
Only one of ReplaceKeyWith or ReplaceKeyPrefixWith can be specified.
For example, if the object to access is abc/test.txt, KeyPrefixEquals is set to abc/, and ReplaceKeyPrefixWith is set to def/, the Location header is `http://example.com/def/test.txt`
ReplaceKeyPrefixWith.description_zh:
Redirect时Object名称的前缀将替换成该值。如果前缀为空，则将这个字符串插入Object名称的前面。
仅允许存在ReplaceKeyWith或ReplaceKeyPrefixWith节点。
假设要访问的Object为abc/test.txt，如果设置KeyPrefixEquals为abc/，ReplaceKeyPrefixWith为def/，则Location头为`http://example.com/def/test.txt`
ReplaceKeyPrefixWith.title: Redirect时Object名称的前缀将替换成该值。如果前缀为空，则将这个字符串插入Object名称的前面。

ReplaceKeyWith.description_en:
The string that replaces the object name during the redirect. ReplaceKeyWith supports variables. The supported variable is ${key}, which represents the object name in the request.
For example, if the object to access is test and ReplaceKeyWith is set to `prefix/${key}.suffix`, the Location header is `http://example.com/prefix/test.suffix`
ReplaceKeyWith.description_zh:
Redirect时Object名称将替换成ReplaceKeyWith指定的值，ReplaceKeyWith支持设置变量。目前支持的变量为${key}，表示该请求中的Object名称。
假设要访问的Object为test，如果设置ReplaceKeyWith为`prefix/${key}.suffix`，则Location头为`http://example.com/prefix/test.suffix`
ReplaceKeyWith.title: Redirect时Object名称将替换成ReplaceKeyWith指定的值，ReplaceKeyWith支持设置变量。目前支持的变量为${key}，表示该请求中的Object名称。
